query:
SELECT tt.id, tt.amount, tt.reason, tt.description, tt.balanceAfter, tt.createdAt,
       au.email, au.tokenBalance
FROM token_transactions tt
JOIN app_users au ON au.id = tt.appUserId
WHERE au.email = 'ladaatn@gmail.com'
ORDER BY tt.createdAt DESC;
